question.worked_solution:
Here, we have the product of two functions $u(x)=\operatorname{tan}⁡(x)$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{log}⁡(x).$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={(\operatorname{tan}⁡(x))}^{′}\operatorname{log}⁡(x)+\operatorname{tan}⁡(x){(\operatorname{log}⁡(x))}^{′} \\  & =({sec}^{2}⁡(x))(\operatorname{log}⁡(x))+(\operatorname{tan}⁡(x))(\frac{1}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡(10)}) \\  & ={sec}^{2}⁡(x)\operatorname{log}⁡(x)+\frac{\operatorname{tan}⁡(x)}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡(10)}\end{aligned}
$$
